long_biography.plain_text:
Fenmarc's move from wholesale vegetables to retailer-ready prepared food became the operating challenge that defined Mark Harrod's ownership. Following the 2002 management buyout, the company expanded its Elm factory and installed successive generations of automated packing equipment while concentrating on retail customers.

A later acquisition of long-standing supplier Alfred G. Pearce restored a direct route into farming and created a more integrated field-to-plate supply chain. Harrod has also developed a separate hospitality interest through Agellus Hotels. Restaurant experience from that business now feeds Fenmarc's product development, while professional executives lead daily operations and Harrod remains an active owner-director across both groups.
